name: Walmart OnePay CashRewards

apr.notes: 20.99% or 31.49% based on creditworthiness. Varies with Prime Rate. Minimum interest charge $2.00. Late payment fee up to $41.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee. Non-USD transactions converted using exchange rates from transaction/processing date.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; WalletHub reports 640+ credit score needed. If not approved for CashRewards, may be considered for OnePay Walmart Spend Card (store-only).

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all other purchases anywhere Mastercard is accepted

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back earned as OnePay Points. Redeemable as statement credit, electronic deposit into OnePay deposit account, or eligible gift cards. 100 points = $1.00. Minimum 25 points for redemption. Walmart+ membership ($12.95/month or $98/year) required for 5% rate.

signup_bonus.description: Get $35 cash back after spending $75 on purchases within 30 days after card opening. Awarded as points redeemable into OnePay deposit account or as statement credit.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: No annual fee for the OnePay CashRewards Card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fee
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fee charged on non-USD purchases.

benefits.title: Spending Insights
benefits.description: Get insights about everyday credit card spending habits through the OnePay app.

benefits.title: Card Lock
benefits.description: Lock your credit card if lost or stolen via the OnePay app.

benefits.title: Free Credit Score
benefits.description: OnePay Credit Score provides real-time updates and insights into your credit, for free.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. Official product page is on onepay.com (Synchrony does not host a dedicated page on synchrony.com for this card). World Mastercard.
